programmes.d: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.
East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.
